identification: Penfolds Clare/Barossa Shiraz Bin 431 vintage 1962, PW Ltd shield label, 1 pt 6 fl oz (about 738ml), embossed Penfolds bottle, red waxed paper capsule. Label torn across top and stained down the middle, capsule cracked with dark marks on top, bottle dusty, fill appears around base of neck to high shoulder. Bin 431 is an ordinary commercial bin, not a Special Bin (not Grange 95, 60A, 389 etc); no web record of Bin 431 at auction found.

viewing_check: Check fill level against the shoulder (ullage), whether any seepage or sticky residue shows below the cracked capsule, whether the cork is pushed or leaking, and the label wording (bin number and vintage clear). Fill below mid-shoulder or leaking means near zero as a wine and decorative value only.
